bio.text: Moira Rader was elected in November 2022 to represent the 98th District, which covers Guilford and Branford.
She earned a B.A. from Villanova University and a master of science from Columbia University's Graduate School of Architecture, Planning and Preservation.
She has worked in architecture, historic preservation, interior design, planning and real estate for over 25 years and has served on the Guilford Board of Education.
She lives in the Mulberry Point neighborhood of Guilford.
